investigations.summary: ui / @ia: pmm-qa#1515 moved the last CodeceptJS @ia scenarios to Playwright. pmm3-ui-tests' CodeceptJS stage now finds 0 tests and exits 1 ('No tests found by pattern: /@ia/'), so the Playwright stage that holds @ia is skipped. Reproduced locally (exit 1 on main; exit 0 with DONT_FAIL_ON_EMPTY_RUN). The fix sets that variable, matching Playwright's --pass-with-no-tests.

nightly / ha: pmm3-ha-eks #343 hit the vmauth.yaml b64dec error again (HELM_CHART_BRANCH=main). #4493 fixed this on master, but pmm3-nightly-orchestrator reads its Jenkinsfile from branch claude/meeting-action-items-qw3ogn (PR #4489), which is 6 commits behind master and still has 'main'. Merge master into #4489's branch, or point the job at master.

ha: PMM-T2109 failed 3/3 because PUT /v1/server/settings returned 400 'Data retention ... is set via PMM_DATA_RETENTION'. The PMM-HA-GA chart has pinned retention since percona-helm-charts#933 (PMM-14787, merged 09-28), which is intended, so the test now changes only the public address. HA verification run is pending.
ha: PMM-T2233/PMM-T2144 leaderStatus timed out again on the left-menu leader that PMM-13860 removed (pmm3-ha-tests #99). Open PR #1512 already covers it.
